page.content:
Ferrari's home race at Monza.

How Italian Grand Prix connects

  • Location: Monza — The Italian Grand Prix is run at Monza.
  • Faction: Scuderia Ferrari — Ferrari's home grand prix is the Italian Grand Prix at Monza.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — The Italian Grand Prix is Ferrari's home Formula 1 race.

What is Italian Grand Prix?

The Italian Grand Prix at Monza is Ferrari's home grand prix, a high-speed Sunday the tifosi treat as a national holiday when the red cars win.

Key threads lead to Monza, Scuderia Ferrari and Formula 1.
